title: Market Intelligence weekly summary for the week ending on 21st August
author: One-Cellist-8159
selftext:
In this week’s EdgeCipher Market Intelligence update, I break down the visual story of the US equity market - where capital is rotating, how money flow is shifting across sectors, and what setups are worth watching heading into the next week.

Money flow analysis highlighting institutional activity
